title: 第19章 匡扶截教大业在于诸位青渊上阐教第20章 大师兄疯了刚教训完截教就来教训阐教
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 上清峰下。
众多截教记名弟子注视着那道身影，心头颤抖，终于感受到了当初先入门的师兄师姐们的恐惧，原来大师兄是真敢杀人啊！
多宝、金灵、无当一众亦是沉默。
他们都在青渊入门后很多年时间，方才拜入老师座下。
对于青渊在老师心中地位如何，并不得知。
只是知道这个大师兄平日十分低调，每次老师讲完道以后便回道场，沉默寡言少与他人接触。
老师，也并未展露出对他特别照顾。
再加上青渊师兄展现出来的道行很低，逐渐被他们轻视。
可今日一看，老师对青渊未免太过于重视了吧？杀两百多人驱除六百多人，近乎把截教三分之一的人给赶走了，却都还没有受到惩罚？
反而成立了什么巡检司？
一旁看戏的人教、阐教亦是感到不可思议。
没想到桀骜不驯的截教弟子，竟然会在青渊面前温驯无比。
正当众人肃然时。
青渊开口道：“我截教愿为洪荒众生开一线生机，不论任何跟脚出身、罪恶与否，不论你们过去如何，但只要入了截教，便要遵纪守法，弘扬我圣教门徒的风范，他日若是让我知道谁打着截教的旗号做尽坏事，便不要怪我心狠手辣清理门户了！”
加入截教。
便有截教气运笼罩、圣人大旗竖起，洪荒绝大多数势力绝对是不会招惹。
便是多了个保命招牌。
在量劫之中，亦是能够脱身事外。
还能听圣人讲道学习超脱证道之法，好处数不胜数。
福利待遇都到这地步了，都还要作恶掠夺杀人夺宝，这种人留在门里做什么呢？
“我等，谨记大师兄教诲！”
众多记名弟子战战兢兢。
“嗯，随后我点些名，点到名的师弟师妹还请暂留一下。”
青渊扫视人群，开口道：“多宝、金灵、无当、虬首仙、定光仙、金箍仙、金光仙、毗芦仙、石矶、马元暂且留下，我有事吩咐，其他师弟可以先离去了。”
多宝道人一众留在原地。
青渊突然朝众人躬身拱手道：“截教关乎我等未来，门风不正将会导致诸般因果加身，还请诸位师弟师妹未来一同与我扶持巡检司维护截教内部风气、法纪人心，拜托了！
“大师兄，您这是做什么？”
“我们受不得如此大礼，您快快起来！”
“您看得起我们，我们开心才是，怎敢不从啊……”
众人都慌了，纷纷避让这一礼。
尤其是多宝道人、金灵圣母与无当圣母几人，内心慌得不行。
“匡扶截教大业在于诸位啊！”
青渊声音诚恳，让众人动容，纷纷答应加入了巡检司。
只是马元突然挠了挠后脑勺，有些不好意思道：“大师兄，我平日间有些不良喜好，就是……就是喜欢挖些生灵心脏用来练功，这您也愿意让我加入巡检司吗？”
“过往如何，那是你过去的事情，以后加入截教便不要再修炼这种旁门左道了，有伤天和。”
青渊沉声道：“如果你愿意，改日可以来我道场清幽峰，我为你指点一门神通大道修行，如何？”
“多谢大师兄！”
马元眼下不过小小真仙后期。
面对截教首徒金仙大修亲口说要教他修行，怎么会不愿意呢？
“嗯，不如诸位且先坐下一叙？”
青渊从储物法宝中变出一张石桌与凳子，待众人坐下，又拿出仙露灵果招待，与众人敲定着建立巡检司之事。
此事。
content_en:
Under the clear peak.
Many registered disciples of Jiejiao stared at that figure, their hearts trembling, and they finally felt the fear of the senior brothers and sisters who started the apprenticeship first. It turned out that the senior brother really dared to kill people!
Duobao, Jinling, and Wudang were also silent.
It took them many years after they started studying in Qingyuan before becoming their teacher.
I don't know what Qingyuan's status is in the teacher's mind.
I just know that this senior brother is very low-key on weekdays. Every time the teacher finishes his sermon, he returns to the dojo. He is taciturn and rarely interacts with others.
The teacher did not show any special care for him.
In addition, Senior Brother Qingyuan showed very low moral conduct and was gradually despised by them.
But today, I saw that the teacher paid too much attention to Qingyuan, right? Killed more than 200 people and drove out more than 600 people, almost driving away a third of the Jiejiao people, but they were still not punished?
What kind of inspection department was established instead?
The people watching the show, Jiao and Qianjiao, were also surprised.
Unexpectedly, the rebellious Jiejiao disciples would actually be extremely docile in front of Qingyuan.
Just when everyone was in awe.
Qingyuan said: "I, the Jie Jiao, are willing to open a ray of hope for all sentient beings in the wilderness. No matter who you are, whether you are guilty or not, and no matter what your past is, as long as you join the Jie Jiao, you must abide by the laws and promote the disciples of my holy religion. If one day I find out who has done all the bad things under the banner of Jie Jiao, don't blame me for ruthlessly cleaning up the family!"
Join Jiejiao.
Then the fate of Jiejiao is shrouded, the banner of saint is raised, and most of the forces in the ancient world will definitely not provoke him.
Just one more life-saving sign.
Even in the midst of calamity, one can escape.
You can also listen to the sermons of saints and learn the methods of transcendental enlightenment. The benefits are countless.
Welfare benefits have reached this point, but they still commit evil, plunder, kill, and seize treasures. What do people like this do if they stay behind the scenes?
"I'll wait and remember Senior Brother's teachings!"
Many named disciples were trembling with fear.
"Well, then I will call some names. Those junior brothers and sisters whose names are called please stay for a moment."
Qingyuan scanned the crowd and said: "Duobao, Jinling, Wudang, Qiushouxian, Dingguangxian, Jinhuxian, Jinguangxian, Piluxian, Shiji, and Ma Yuan will stay for now. I have something to give, and other junior brothers can leave first."
"Yes!"
Taoist Duobao stayed where they were.
Qingyuan suddenly bowed to everyone and said with his hands: "Jiejiao is related to our future. Improper family conduct will lead to all kinds of karma. I also ask all the junior brothers and sisters to work with me in the future to support the Inspection Department to maintain the internal atmosphere, law and discipline of Jiejiao and people's hearts. Please!
! "
"Elder brother, what are you doing?"
"We can't bear such a big gift, please get up quickly!"
"You think highly of us and we are happy. How dare you disobey..."
Everyone panicked and avoided the gift.
Especially Taoist Duobao, Our Lady of Jinling and Our Lady of Wudang, they were extremely panicked.
"The great cause of supporting and teaching lies with you!"
Qing Yuan's sincere voice moved everyone, and they all agreed to join the Inspection Department.
But Ma Yuan suddenly scratched the back of his head and said with some embarrassment: "Senior Brother, I have some bad hobbies in my daily life, that is... I just like to dig out the hearts of living beings to practice martial arts. Are you willing to let me join the Inspection Department?"
"What's the past? That's your past. If you join the Jie Cult in the future, don't practice such heresy anymore. It will harm Tianhe."
Qingyuan said in a deep voice: "If you are willing, you can come to my dojo, Qingyou Peak, some other time, and I will teach you a magical way to practice. How about it?"
"Thank you, senior brother!"
Ma Yuan is only in the late stage of Little True Immortal.
Faced with Jinxian Daxiu, the first disciple of Jiejiao, who personally said that he wanted to teach him how to practice, how could he be unwilling?
"Well, why don't you all sit down and talk for a while?"
Qingyuan conjured a stone table and stools from the storage magic weapon. When everyone sat down, he took out the fairy dew fruit to entertain them, and finalized the establishment of the inspection department with everyone.
